data.description:
## Description
**What**: Reclassify ast-grep from optional to required in onboarding/SKILL.md and INSTALL.md, add an identity-probe dependency check that hard-exits non-zero when ast-grep is absent or when the only sg on PATH is the Linux shadow-utils setgid /usr/bin/sg, and convert all DSO scripts to invoke the long-form ast-grep binary.
**Why**: A bare command -v sg can resolve to the shadow-utils newgrp tool, silently running the wrong binary and defeating every downstream ast-grep consumer.
**Scope**:
- IN: identity probe parsing sg --version and accepting only ast-grep >= 0.20; hard-exit non-zero with an error naming ast-grep plus a recommended install command (cargo/npm/brew); onboarding/SKILL.md and INSTALL.md required-dependency + shadow-utils collision docs; conversion of DSO script call sites to the long-form binary.
- OUT: /dso:doctor changes; CI precondition wiring.

## Done Definitions

- An onboarding run with ast-grep absent and a decoy setgid sg on PATH exits non-zero and the error output contains the string ast-grep and a recommended install command ← Satisfies: sc-2
- The identity probe parses sg --version and rejects any sg that is not ast-grep at version 0.20 or greater ← Satisfies: sc-2
- onboarding/SKILL.md and INSTALL.md list ast-grep as required with minimum version 0.20, cargo/npm/brew install instructions, and the /usr/bin/sg shadow-utils collision note ← Validates Closure Check: "onboarding docs list ast-grep as required (minimum version >= 0.20) with install instructions (cargo/npm/brew) and document the /usr/bin/sg shadow-utils collision."
- Every DSO script that invokes structural search calls the long-form ast-grep binary rather than the bare sg alias ← Satisfies: sc-2
- Unit tests written and passing for the identity probe across the absent, decoy-shadow, and valid-ast-grep cases ← Satisfies: sc-2

## Considerations

- [Build] New .sh files set the executable bit (chmod +x) on creation.
- [Coordination] onboarding/SKILL.md is shared with the Java onboarding epic (70d5); coordinate hard-exit semantics to avoid divergent exit-code contracts.
- [Risk] Onboarding hard-exit does not propagate to CI; note a follow-up to add a CI ast-grep precondition before planning jobs (out of this story's scope).

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO operator, I want ast-grep enforced as a required onboarding dependency with shadow-utils disambiguation, so that the atomicity check never runs against the wrong binary.
